cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You've thanked the wedding guests. What about the person who cooked? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you made the food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then why does the programme thank 'the buffet'?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The buffet would like its surname pronounced correctly.
